name: Bruce McKenzie
bio: Bruce's motorsport journey began in the outback, tinkering with engines and dreaming of Formula One. After a brief stint as a mechanic for a local racing team, he realized his true passion lay in strategy. He enrolled in online courses and devoured every motorsport strategy book he could find, honing his analytical skills. Although new to the top tiers, Bruce is eager to prove himself and believes his methodical approach to data analysis and race simulations will give any team a competitive edge. He's particularly interested in maximizing tire life and exploiting unexpected weather conditions.

physical.description: Bruce is a stocky man with a weathered face, suggesting a life spent outdoors.

quirks: Always carries a well-worn notebook filled with racing stats.
Has a habit of tapping his pen while deep in thought.
Prefers to work in complete silence, even in a bustling garage.
